keyPoints.en: Male: testes (sperm, testosterone), epididymis (stores sperm), sperm duct, seminal vesicle and prostate (fluid), urethra, penis.
keyPoints.bm: Lelaki: testis (sperma, testosteron), epididimis (simpan sperma), duktus sperma, vesikel semen dan prostat (bendalir), uretra, zakar.

keyPoints.en: Female: ovaries (ova, oestrogen, progesterone), Fallopian tubes (fertilisation), uterus (foetus develops), cervix, vagina.
keyPoints.bm: Perempuan: ovari (ovum, estrogen, progesteron), tiub Falopio (persenyawaan), uterus (fetus berkembang), serviks, faraj.

keyPoints.en: Testes are outside the body (scrotum) because sperm production needs a temperature ~2–3 °C below body temperature.
keyPoints.bm: Testis berada di luar badan (skrotum) kerana penghasilan sperma memerlukan suhu ~2–3 °C lebih rendah daripada suhu badan.

keyPoints.en: Puberty is triggered by hormones: testosterone in boys, oestrogen in girls (secondary sexual characteristics).
keyPoints.bm: Akil baligh dicetuskan oleh hormon: testosteron pada lelaki, estrogen pada perempuan (ciri seks sekunder).

question.en: Where does fertilisation normally take place?

tip.en: Practise labelling both reproductive system diagrams with functions.
tip.bm: Berlatih melabel kedua-dua rajah sistem pembiakan dengan fungsinya.

keyPoints.en: Gametogenesis uses meiosis to make haploid gametes (n = 23).
keyPoints.bm: Gametogenesis menggunakan meiosis untuk menghasilkan gamet haploid (n = 23).

keyPoints.en: Spermatogenesis (testes): spermatogonium → primary spermatocyte → secondary spermatocytes → spermatids → 4 sperm. Continuous from puberty.
keyPoints.bm: Spermatogenesis (testis): spermatogonium → spermatosit primer → spermatosit sekunder → spermatid → 4 sperma. Berterusan dari akil baligh.

keyPoints.en: Oogenesis (ovaries): oogonium → primary oocyte (formed before birth) → secondary oocyte + polar body → ovum after fertilisation.
keyPoints.bm: Oogenesis (ovari): oogonium → oosit primer (terbentuk sebelum lahir) → oosit sekunder + jasad kutub → ovum selepas persenyawaan.

keyPoints.en: One functional ovum per primary oocyte because cytoplasm divides unequally.
keyPoints.bm: Satu ovum berfungsi bagi setiap oosit primer kerana sitoplasma membahagi tidak sama rata.

question.en: Why is the ovum much larger than the sperm?
question.bm: Mengapa ovum jauh lebih besar daripada sperma?

answer.en: It stores food and organelles for the early embryo; the sperm only needs to swim and deliver its nucleus.
answer.bm: Ia menyimpan makanan dan organel untuk embrio awal; sperma hanya perlu berenang dan menghantar nukleusnya.

tip.en: Compare: place, timing, number of gametes, size, mobility.
tip.bm: Bandingkan: tempat, masa, bilangan gamet, saiz, pergerakan.

keyPoints.en: Days 1–5: menstruation — endometrium shed.
keyPoints.bm: Hari 1–5: haid — endometrium disingkirkan.

keyPoints.en: FSH (pituitary) stimulates a follicle to grow; the follicle secretes oestrogen, which rebuilds the endometrium.
keyPoints.bm: FSH (pituitari) merangsang folikel membesar; folikel merembes estrogen yang membina semula endometrium.

keyPoints.en: Around day 14, an LH surge causes ovulation; the follicle becomes the corpus luteum.
keyPoints.bm: Sekitar hari ke-14, lonjakan LH menyebabkan ovulasi; folikel menjadi korpus luteum.

keyPoints.en: Corpus luteum secretes progesterone to maintain the endometrium; if no pregnancy, it degenerates and menstruation begins.
keyPoints.bm: Korpus luteum merembes progesteron untuk mengekalkan endometrium; jika tiada kehamilan, ia merosot dan haid bermula.

keyPoints.en: Premenstrual syndrome (PMS) and menopause are linked to changing hormone levels.
keyPoints.bm: Sindrom pra-haid (PMS) dan menopaus berkaitan dengan perubahan aras hormon.

question.en: Why does progesterone stay high during pregnancy?
question.bm: Mengapa progesteron kekal tinggi semasa hamil?

answer.en: The corpus luteum and later the placenta keep secreting it to maintain the endometrium.
answer.bm: Korpus luteum dan kemudiannya plasenta terus merembesnya untuk mengekalkan endometrium.

tip.en: Sketch the 4 hormone curves against days 1–28 — very common in exams.
tip.bm: Lakar 4 lengkung hormon melawan hari 1–28 — sangat biasa dalam peperiksaan.

keyPoints.en: Fertilisation in the Fallopian tube → diploid zygote.
keyPoints.bm: Persenyawaan dalam tiub Falopio → zigot diploid.

keyPoints.en: Zygote divides by mitosis (cleavage) → morula → blastocyst, which implants in the endometrium (~day 7).
keyPoints.bm: Zigot membahagi secara mitosis (pembelahan) → morula → blastosista yang menempel pada endometrium (~hari ke-7).

keyPoints.en: Placenta and umbilical cord: O₂, glucose, amino acids, antibodies pass to the foetus; CO₂ and urea pass to the mother.
keyPoints.bm: Plasenta dan tali pusat: O₂, glukosa, asid amino, antibodi ke fetus; CO₂ dan urea ke ibu.

keyPoints.en: Harmful substances (nicotine, alcohol, some drugs and viruses) can cross the placenta — avoid them during pregnancy.
keyPoints.bm: Bahan berbahaya (nikotina, alkohol, sesetengah ubat dan virus) boleh merentasi plasenta — elakkan semasa hamil.

keyPoints.en: Amniotic fluid cushions the foetus and keeps temperature stable.
keyPoints.bm: Bendalir amnion melindungi fetus daripada hentakan dan menstabilkan suhu.

question.en: Why should pregnant mothers not smoke?
question.bm: Mengapa ibu hamil tidak boleh merokok?

answer.en: Nicotine and CO cross the placenta, reducing O₂ to the foetus and causing low birth weight.
answer.bm: Nikotina dan CO merentasi plasenta, mengurangkan O₂ ke fetus dan menyebabkan berat lahir rendah.

tip.en: The placenta is a 'filter' — but not a perfect one.

keyPoints.en: Identical (monozygotic) twins: one zygote splits into two embryos — same genes, same sex.
keyPoints.bm: Kembar seiras (monozigot): satu zigot terbahagi kepada dua embrio — gen sama, jantina sama.

keyPoints.en: Fraternal (dizygotic) twins: two ova fertilised by two sperm — genes differ like normal siblings.
keyPoints.bm: Kembar tak seiras (dizigot): dua ovum disenyawakan oleh dua sperma — gen berbeza seperti adik-beradik biasa.

keyPoints.en: Identical twins usually share one placenta; fraternal twins have separate placentas.
keyPoints.bm: Kembar seiras biasanya berkongsi satu plasenta; kembar tak seiras mempunyai plasenta berasingan.

keyPoints.en: Conjoined (Siamese) twins: the zygote splits incompletely.
keyPoints.bm: Kembar siam: zigot terbahagi tidak lengkap.

question.en: Can fraternal twins be a boy and a girl?
question.bm: Bolehkah kembar tak seiras terdiri daripada lelaki dan perempuan?

answer.en: Yes — they come from two different sperm, one carrying X and one carrying Y.
answer.bm: Ya — mereka berasal daripada dua sperma berbeza, satu membawa X dan satu membawa Y.

tip.en: Mono = one zygote; Di = two zygotes.
tip.bm: Mono = satu zigot; Di = dua zigot.

keyPoints.en: Infertility causes: low sperm count, blocked Fallopian tubes, hormonal imbalance.
keyPoints.bm: Punca kemandulan: bilangan sperma rendah, tiub Falopio tersumbat, ketidakseimbangan hormon.

keyPoints.en: Assisted reproduction: IVF, artificial insemination, sperm/egg banks.
keyPoints.bm: Pembiakan berbantu: IVF, permanian beradas, bank sperma/telur.

keyPoints.en: Sexually transmitted infections: syphilis, gonorrhoea, HIV/AIDS, HPV.
keyPoints.bm: Jangkitan kelamin: sifilis, gonorea, HIV/AIDS, HPV.

keyPoints.en: Cancers: cervical (screen with Pap smear; HPV vaccine), breast, prostate, testicular.
keyPoints.bm: Kanser: serviks (saringan Pap smear; vaksin HPV), payudara, prostat, testis.

question.en: How does a blocked Fallopian tube cause infertility?
question.bm: Bagaimana tiub Falopio tersumbat menyebabkan kemandulan?

answer.en: Sperm can't reach the ovum, so fertilisation can't occur.
answer.bm: Sperma tidak dapat sampai ke ovum, jadi persenyawaan tidak berlaku.

tip.en: Link each problem to the stage of reproduction it blocks.
tip.bm: Kaitkan setiap masalah dengan peringkat pembiakan yang terhalang.

keyPoints.en: Growth: a permanent increase in size, mass and number of cells.
keyPoints.bm: Pertumbuhan: pertambahan kekal dalam saiz, jisim dan bilangan sel.

keyPoints.en: Measured by height, fresh mass or dry mass (most accurate, but destroys the organism).
keyPoints.bm: Diukur melalui ketinggian, jisim segar atau jisim kering (paling tepat, tetapi memusnahkan organisma).

keyPoints.en: Humans: sigmoid curve with two growth spurts (infancy and puberty).
keyPoints.bm: Manusia: lengkung sigmoid dengan dua fasa pesat (bayi dan akil baligh).

keyPoints.en: Insects and crustaceans: step-shaped (intermittent) curve due to moulting (ecdysis).
keyPoints.bm: Serangga dan krustasia: lengkung bentuk tangga (berselang) akibat salinan kulit (ekdisis).

keyPoints.en: Growth depends on nutrition, hormones (growth hormone, thyroxine), genes and health.
keyPoints.bm: Pertumbuhan bergantung pada nutrisi, hormon (hormon pertumbuhan, tiroksina), gen dan kesihatan.

question.en: Why do girls usually have their growth spurt earlier than boys?
question.bm: Mengapa perempuan biasanya mengalami pertumbuhan pesat lebih awal daripada lelaki?

answer.en: Girls usually reach puberty earlier (~10–12 years) than boys (~12–14).
answer.bm: Perempuan biasanya akil baligh lebih awal (~10–12 tahun) berbanding lelaki (~12–14).

tip.en: Gradient of a growth curve = growth rate.
